title: Engineering Project Engineer
description:
Job Title: Engineering Project Engineer
Location: Chicago, IL
Job Type and Duration: On-Site, Direct-Hire
Pay range: $80,000 - $100,000

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Project Manager to lead and coordinate engineering projects while serving as the primary point of contact for clients. This is a client-facing role that requires strong project management, communication, and organizational skills to ensure successful project execution from planning through delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, manage, and oversee engineering projects from initiation through completion.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and resource plans using Microsoft Project or similar scheduling tools.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing regular project updates and addressing concerns.
  • Coordinate with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and other cross-functional teams to ensure project milestones are met.
  • Identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Monitor project performance, ensuring deliverables meet quality, schedule, and budget requirements.
  • Prepare and present project status reports to internal leadership and clients.
  • Foster effective communication among stakeholders to support successful project outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science/Engineering
  • Minimum of 2-years of project management experience in an engineering environment, preferably electrical.
  • Experience using Microsoft Project or other project scheduling and planning software.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, budgets, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong understanding of design procedures, quality standards, and DO-160 testing.
  • Strong client-facing experience with the ability to build and maintain professional relationships.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the aerospace or defense industry.
  • Familiarity with engineering development lifecycles, technical documentation, and project reporting.

title: Manufacturing Production Supervisor
description:
Job Title: Manufacturing Production Supervisor
Location: Rockford, IL area
Job Type and Duration: Direct Hire
Pay range: 65-90/k

Job Title: Production Supervisor

Job Overview: The Production Supervisor plays a critical role in overseeing the daily operations of the production floor. This position is responsible for ensuring that production processes run efficiently, meeting safety, quality, and production targets. The Production Supervisor will manage a team of production workers, ensuring that all operations are completed on time, within budget, and according to the company's high standards.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Supervision and Coordination:
    • Oversee daily production activities, ensuring that production schedules are met.
    • Conduct daily meetings with production staff to review operational goals, set priorities, and communicate changes.
    • Coordinate with other departments, including Maintenance and Shipping, to ensure smooth production flow.
  • Production Management:
    • Monitor production processes to ensure efficiency and adherence to quality standards.
    • Direct and oversee the setup, operation, and maintenance of production equipment.
    • Ensure that all materials required for production are available and correctly prepared.
  • Safety and Quality Assurance:
    • Enforce safety protocols and ensure compliance with all safety regulations.
    • Oversee quality control measures, ensuring that all products meet company and customer specifications.
    • Conduct regular inspections of the production area to ensure cleanliness and compliance.
  • Team Leadership and Development:
    • Provide leadership and direction to the production team, fostering a positive work environment.
    • Train and develop production workers, ensuring they have the skills needed to perform their duties effectively.
    • Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to production staff, setting goals and objectives for improvement.
  • Continuous Improvement:
    • Identify areas for process improvement and implement strategies to enhance productivity and efficiency.
    • Work closely with the Plant Manager to develop and implement policies and procedures that support the company's operational goals.
    • Participate in cross-functional teams to drive process improvements and cost reduction initiatives.
  • Administrative Duties:
    • Maintain accurate records of production output, downtime, and other key metrics.
    • Prepare and submit reports to the Plant Manager on production performance and any issues that arise.
    • Manage timekeeping and attendance records for production staff, ensuring compliance with company policies.
Qualifications:
  • Proven experience in a supervisory role within a manufacturing and production environment.
  • 3-5 years of experience in CNC Turning, Milling, or general machine job shop
  • Strong understanding of production processes, safety standards, and quality control practices.
  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and develop a diverse team.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve operational issues quickly.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, manage multiple tasks simultaneously, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) and familiarity with ERP systems.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills can interact effectively with all levels of the organization.

title: Global Mobility Coordinator
description:
Global Mobility Coordinator
3 month contract
San Antonio, TX

Job Description:
The Global Mobility team supports the safe and seamless movement of employees domestically and internationally, they are a key operator within the Global Mobility Department, focusing on the administrative and customer service elements of employee movement. This role is dedicated to providing high-quality support for personnel on both short-term and long-term field assignments, ensuring operational efficiency across payroll and expense systems.

Core Responsibilities
System Administration & JIRA Workflows
Concur Access: Manage system access requests within Concur. To include troubleshooting access issues.
Delegate Management: Administer and audit delegate access to ensure proper system permissions.
Termination Procedures: Execute "Termed Employee " protocols, specifically the final confirmation and reconciliation of outstanding employee expenses.
Data Auditing: Regularly monitor and resolve Concur error reports within the HCM system to maintain data integrity.
Mobility & Relocation Support
Case Coordination: Support the end-to-end mobility experience for employees on international assignments or domestic relocations, ensuring a seamless transition for the assignee
Compliance & Monitoring: Partner with immigration vendors to maintain strict compliance with visas and immunizations while proactively monitoring travel schedules for potential tax implications.
Documentation: Process relocation initiations, draft necessary documentation, and notify relevant business partners.
Liaison Services: Act as a point of contact for external vendors, ensuring they meet service standards for immigration and tax support.
Travel Logistics: Perform booking and ticketing for travel as required by assignment needs.
Orientation & Alignment: Schedule and conduct orientations for travelers, ensuring all departments are aligned and maintaining detailed flight logs and network day tracking.

Customer Service & Training
Employee Inquiry: Resolve day-to-day employee inquiries regarding mobility initiatives and expense policies.
User Training: Conduct training calls for new SAP Concur users to ensure they understand system navigation and compliance.
Data Maintenance: Update and maintain assignee files and mobility data within SharePoint and other internal systems.
Invoice Management: Oversee the timely processing and payment of invoices for all global mobility vendors.

Requirements & Skills
Experience: 2–3 years of relevant global coordination or international mobility experience.
Technical Skills: Proficient with Microsoft Office 365, with a strong emphasis on Excel for data management.
Velocity: Proven ability to handle a large case load at high velocity while maintaining a focus on customer experience.
Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to convey complex guidance to customers and teammates.

Education:
High school diploma or equivalent is required;
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration is preferred.

Work Environment
Corporate Culture: This position operates out of a professional, fast-paced corporate headquarters in San Antonio, TX.
Collaboration: Work is performed in contemporary open workspaces and conference rooms, requiring frequent collaboration with Payroll and Legal teams.

Physical Expectations: Must be able to communicate via phone, video chat, and software systems; occasional site visits requiring Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) may occur.

title: Ground Improvement Design Engineer
description:
Job Title: Ground Improvement Design Engineer
Location: (3 locations): Houston, TX; Atlanta, GA; and Charleston, SC
Job Type and Duration:6-months On-Site, then Hybrid; Direct-Hire
Pay range: $90,000 - $120,000

Overview
Ground Improvement Design Engineer with 2–5 years of experience to support the growing portfolio of geotechnical construction projects across the U.S. This role is ideal for an engineer who wants to move beyond traditional consulting into a design-build environment, working on complex, high-impact projects and seeing designs carried through construction.

We are especially interested in candidates with direct ground improvement or specialty geotechnical contracting experience, but we will also consider strong candidates from geotechnical consulting firms.

Key Responsibilities
  • Perform design and analysis for ground improvement systems and geotechnical structures
  • Support estimating teams with technical input and optimized solutions during bid phase
  • Develop construction-ready calculations and drawings
  • Provide engineering support during construction, including troubleshooting field conditions
  • Participate in load test programs (design, execution, interpretation)
  • Work closely with estimating, operations, CAD, and project management teams from proposal through construction.
  • Contribute to development of design tools, automation, and efficiency improvements
Typical project scopes include ground improvement, deep foundations, earth retention, slope stabilization, and underpinning.

Required / Desired Qualifications
  • 2–5 years experience in geotechnical or ground improvement engineering
  • Degree in Civil Engineering (Master's preferred, Bachelor's acceptable)
  • FE required. PE license or ability to obtain within 1 to 2 years preferred.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Geotechnical engineering fundamentals
    • Soil Mechanics
    • Foundation design and settlement behavior
  • Experience with design tools such as:
    • Settle 3, GeoStudio, PLAXIS, Mathcad (or similar)
  • Strong proficiency with Excel and engineering software. Experience with Python, VBA, automation tools, or AI-assisted workflows is a plus.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, design-build environment

Logistics & Expectations
  • In-office requirement: Full-time for the first 6 month and then hybrid option will be available
  • Training: Initial 3–4 weeks of travel (home on weekends; all travel covered)
  • Career path: Opportunity to quickly develop technical expertise, work on nationally significant projects, and grow into technical leadership or engineering management roles
